# LittleHugs
# Place this at /public/llms.txt so it serves from the site root.

> LittleHugs is a private, five-minute daily wellness check-in for women who hold everything
> together for everyone else. It is a gentle habit and reflection companion — not therapy and
> not a clinical tool. Built for women in India, the UAE and beyond.

## What it is
- A daily check-in that asks how you're really doing and offers a small, kind nudge back.
- Private by design — reflections stay with the user.
- Focused on noticing, calm, boundaries and feeling steadier. No streaks, no pressure.

## The Journal (blog)
- /blogs — everyday wellness writing for women: the mental load, boundaries, reflection,
  feeling steadier, and small self-care habits that fit a packed day.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.littlehugs.online/
- Journal: https://www.littlehugs.online/blogs

## Audience
- Women aged roughly 25–40 carrying work, home and the people who depend on them.
- Primary markets: India and the UAE.
